payload.title: Integrate useful checker, comparison and measurement journeys
payload.goal: Help a visitor identify their toilet, enter measurements and understand compatible/uncertain outcomes accessibly.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Reuse present category checker and guidance; layer exact-model selection and compare up to three eligible products using source-backed constraints.
Validate nonnegative realistic measurements, units, missing/contradictory fields and tolerance boundaries; never turn missing basics into likely fit.
Show source review date, decisive rules, unresolved unknowns, manufacturer verification and merchant return-policy reminder for every result.
Provide printable measurement/photo checklist without uploading images or exact private measurements; optional browser-only save/export/delete makes repeated use practical.
Test responsive keyboard/screen-reader flows, reset, unavailable storage, no-JS explanatory fallback and no implied electrical/plumbing certification.
tests: Boundary/negative/zero/extreme values and mismatched bowl shape are rejected or uncertain; French-curve, concealed plumbing, wall-hung and no-outlet fixtures explain concrete next steps.
No affiliate eligibility changes fit score; source-missing product cannot get a confident fit result.
Browser network inspection shows no measurement or photo leakage; report restore/delete and accessible focus pass.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Visitor completes a useful category or exact-model check and can compare evidence/unknowns without a false fit guarantee.
Saved local report and printable sheet support a later manufacturer conversation without requiring an account.
payload.rollback: Restore prior reviewed checker and keep source corrections; remove only unsupported new model choices.
payload.next_eligible_action: Build browser fixtures around existing broad checker and integrate reviewed evidence schema.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Browser harness and exact-model evidence are dependencies; existing category utility remains reusable.
